Upscaler and frame generation runtimes shipped next to pt.exe

The full licence texts are the other files in this folder. What each one lets the port ship:

AMD FidelityFX SDK v1.1.4 (amd_fidelityfx_vk.dll: FSR 3.1 upscaler and frame generation on
Vulkan; amd_fidelityfx_dx12.dll: FSR 3.1 frame generation on DirectX 12)
  MIT licence (AMD_FidelityFX_SDK_LICENSE.txt). AMD's prebuilt signed DLLs, unmodified.

AMD FSR SDK 2.3.0 (amd_fidelityfx_loader_dx12.dll and amd_fidelityfx_upscaler_dx12.dll: FSR 4
and FSR 3.1 upscalers on DirectX 12)
  AMD FSR SDK licence (AMD_FSR_SDK_2_LICENSE.txt): the signed binaries may be distributed
  in binary form with the licence's notices; no reverse engineering. AMD releases FSR 4 for
  DirectX 12 only, so on Vulkan the menu lists it greyed. It runs on AMD Radeon RX 9000
  and RX 7000 GPUs through AMD's driver.

NVIDIA DLSS SDK 310.9.1 (nvngx_dlss.dll: DLSS Super Resolution; nvngx_dlssd.dll: DLSS Ray
Reconstruction, the denoiser of the Path traced ray quality)
  NVIDIA RTX SDKs licence (NVIDIA_RTX_SDKs_LICENSE.txt): the SDK's binaries may be
  distributed in object code inside an application with material additional functionality,
  only for systems with NVIDIA GPUs, under terms at least as protective as NVIDIA's.

NVIDIA Streamline 2.14.1 (experimental DLSS Frame Generation; builds with PT_STREAMLINE)
  sl.interposer.dll, sl.common.dll, sl.dlss.dll, sl.dlss_g.dll, sl.dlss_d.dll, sl.reflex.dll,
  sl.pcl.dll:
  Streamline is MIT licensed (NVIDIA_Streamline_LICENSE.txt); only NVIDIA's signed
  production builds ship. nvngx_dlssg.dll (DLSS Frame Generation) is under the NVIDIA RTX
  SDKs licence (NVIDIA_Streamline_DLSS_LICENSE.txt). Reflex: NVIDIA_Reflex_LICENSE.txt;
  NvLowLatencyVk.dll is not shipped.

Intel XeSS SDK 3.0.2 (libxess.dll: XeSS Super Resolution; libxess_fg.dll: XeSS Frame
Generation; libxell.dll: Intel Xe Low Latency, which XeSS Frame Generation requires)
  Intel Simplified Software License (Intel_XeSS_SDK_LICENSE.txt): the binaries may be
  redistributed unmodified, and are neither modified nor altered in their operation (the
  port loads them as they are and hooks nothing in them). The third-party components Intel
  lists for the SDK: Intel_XeSS_SDK_third-party-programs.txt. XeSS Frame Generation runs on
  DirectX 12 only; the port presents through a DirectX 12 device for it.

ReShade 6.8.0 (reshade/dxgi.dll: the carrier of the DLSS 5 community route's add-on)
  BSD 3-Clause licence (ReShade_LICENSE.md), copyright Patrick Mours. Built by the port from
  the v6.8.0 source (github.com/crosire/reshade) with its user interface and update check
  switched off (tools/build_reshade.py lists the changes); it is installed only by the
  DLSS 5 route, on the player's request, and removed with it. Not an official ReShade build.

Not shipped, looked for or loaded: any DLSS neural rendering runtime (nvngx_dlssnr.dll)
and any third-party frame generation unlock. NVIDIA, GeForce RTX and DLSS are trademarks of NVIDIA Corporation; AMD and
FidelityFX are trademarks of Advanced Micro Devices; Intel and XeSS are trademarks of
Intel Corporation. P.T. port is not endorsed by NVIDIA, AMD or Intel.
